ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Aug-24-2010 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of an Adult and a Minor.
Dept. 218, Judge: Richard B. Ulmer, Jr., Clerk: S. Ravinantpapricha, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Petitioner Mei Su Tan was present in pro per for self and for Minor Wan Yi Yu, placed under oath and examined.
No appearance by Co-Petitioner (minor's father) Jin Guang Yu, but signed the Petition consenting to the name change for the minor Wan Yi Yu.
Proof of Publication in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to: Amy Meisu Tan and change of name of the Minor to Wendy Wanyi Yu.

Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
